# lexer

## Overview
Generated JFlex lexer implementations (_DartLexer, _DartDocLexer) for tokenizing Dart source code and DartDoc comments.

## Interface
- None public. `_DartLexer` and `_DartDocLexer` are package-private and are consumed through the hand-written `DartLexer` and `DartDocLexer` wrappers in `src/main/java/com/jetbrains/lang/dart/lexer/`.

## Invariants
- Implements com.intellij.lexer.FlexLexer interface.
- Auto-generated by JFlex from [Dart.flex](../../../../../../src/main/java/com/jetbrains/lang/dart/lexer/Dart.flex) and [DartDoc.flex](../../../../../../src/main/java/com/jetbrains/lang/dart/lexer/DartDoc.flex); manual changes should be made to the flex files.

## Side Effects
- Mutates internal DFA state during token scanning (advance()).
